title: handle container: '.sortResults' (multiple container elements)
body: What happens when the container is a class selector like '.stats' if you want to display stats in multiple places?

comments.body:
To be more explicit: What should happen when the specified `container` key resolve to several DOM elements. Should they all get rendered or only the first one.

Use-case is adding several widgets such as "XXX result in YYY ms" or "Order by" at the top and bottom of the search results.

I'd go with all the matching elements
I wonder if we should handle this case or not. Maybe let's wait for it to happen because I am not even sure I have seen such use cases.. ?
I had it on some of the demos I built, but ok for postponing it until we see it live
Will be reopened when there's a clear need for it
